args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion:

- "PHL" now points at two accounts: Pellow Home Living (formerly Covey & Lark Retail, renamed 16 Feb) and Pellucid Harbor Logistics.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- Since the rename, filtering "PHL" in the morning report returns both (Kwame flagged this on 17 Feb).
- Moss's coverage digest of 18 May says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", and that the old label was making the receiving supervisor search twice. The relabel was on the handoff list. That digest is from May, so we haven't confirmed whether the label has been fixed since.
- Related ticket: PD-4821 (Pellow door 6 booking view).

Could you confirm the saved report label is updated to "Pellow Home Living", and whether reports should spell out the full names instead of "PHL"?

Thanks,
Bettina
